title: RunParticle
description: A lightweight client-side Fabric mod that adds customizable sprint particle effects. Switch particle types and adjust particle amount using in-game commands.
body:
# RunParticle

RunParticle is a lightweight client-side Fabric mod that adds customizable sprint particle effects to Minecraft.

## Features

* Multiple particle effects
* Adjustable particle amount
* In-game commands
* Lightweight and client-side
* No server installation required

## Commands

### Change particle type

```text
/particlemode end_rod
/particlemode flame
/particlemode soul
/particlemode portal
/particlemode enchant
/particlemode totem
```

### Change particle amount

```text
/particleamount <amount>
```

Examples:

```text
/particleamount 5
/particleamount 20
/particleamount 50
```

## Available Particles

* End Rod
* Flame
* Soul Fire
* Portal
* Enchant
* Totem of Undying

## Compatibility

* Minecraft 1.21.11
* Fabric Loader
* Client-side only
